//peerDependencies: Deliberately `*`. These are OPTIONAL peers: the plugin declares them so storefronts can see the host packages it integrates with, but it fail-softs at runtime (mover.status capabilities + mover_doctor). npm's prerelease rule evaluates each `||` alternative as a set and only admits a prerelease when a comparator in that set shares the version's exact major.minor.patch tuple AND carries a prerelease tag -- so an upper bound like `<0.2.0-0` excludes EVERY 0.2.0 prerelease, which made the host report 2.2.0 as incompatible with 0.2.0-rc.2. Enumerating release lines would keep producing false incompatibilities on each new line; the real floor is engines.dsh, and capability flags report any actual runtime mismatch. Do NOT narrow these to version ranges.
